mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT em.emp_id, em.emp_name, em.emp_comp_mail FROM emp_mgt as em WHERE em.vehicle_fix_flg = false AND em.logical_del_flg = false ORDER BY em.emp_id

SELECT DISTINCT em.emp_id FROM emp_mgt as em LEFT JOIN vihicle_mgt AS vm ON em.emp_id = vm.emp_id WHERE vm.request_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month' AND vm.request_date < CURRENT_DATE AND em.vehicle_fix_flg = false AND em.logical_del_flg = false AND vm.logical_del_flg = false
